fields.subject: Mapping Expression Builders
fields.condition: the resolved output DbParameter is present (not null)
fields.trigger: ExpressionHelpers builds a binary or array output-parameter read expression via ReadOutParameterBinaryExpressions or ReadOutParameterArrayExpressions
fields.response: assign the property from the parameter's get-method return value: the binary builder calls its single configured get-method directly, while the array builder invokes a get-method made generic over the property's array element type
